APPROVE
The refactor keeps the same short-circuit evaluation order: print rules are skipped, the qualifies/focus/target checks are equivalent, and each declaration is tested with `DrawsIndicator` before the outline/`Outranks` branch. Each method is now well under 15 (about 8 for `RuleReplaces`), and it only uses LINQ that the file already relies on, so it should build cleanly.
